title: MedVision-AI Metrics Record
description: Schema for a metrics record logged to MLflow. Used by metrics_logger.py to validate inputs, and by downstream audit tooling to verify that a run produced all expected metrics.

run_id.description: MLflow run ID that owns these metrics.

step.description: Zero-indexed step at which the metrics were logged.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the metrics were captured.

metrics.description: Mapping of metric name -> numeric value. All values must be finite floats.

context.description: Optional structured context describing where the metrics came from (e.g. fold id, evaluation split).

healthcare_metadata.description: Optional MedVision-specific metadata, e.g. subgroup identifiers for fairness audits.
